title: Thief Gets Busted Stealing Food Then Kicks Police Officer During Arrest
description:
On March 8, 2022, police responded to a Kwik Trip convenience store after receiving a retail theft complaint in La Crosse, WI. A man allegedly stole multiple food items and consumed them in the store's restroom without paying. When police made contact with him, he became upset and resistive to the point where he kicked his fresh bottle of strawberry milk all over the ground.
